verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce documents payment-side capabilities: purchase intents, credential retrieval, and confirming payment outcomes. Nothing shows an agent querying order status or shipment tracking after a purchase. The 'confirm payment outcomes' claim covers payment status only, not order fulfillment or tracking, so it is adjacent rather than direct support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can query the status and tracking of an order it placed, after the purchase

citations.quote: Confirm payment outcomes and trigger post-purchase actions in real-time.
